column1: # Stories surfui.Rows is off by more than the rows gate's tolerance, each
# for a reason that is no estimate's to fix: `<story> <density> <reason>`.
# tip/shown draws each tip card as wide as its text, to the cell (the
# host's own width, cells.DrawTip), so a run of text fits in its card or
# wraps on a fraction of a pixel, in Chromium and Blitz alike: a rounding
# of the font's advance the estimate cannot see.
tip/shown dense a tip card exactly as wide as its text: wraps or not on a fraction of a pixel
tip/shown roomy a tip card exactly as wide as its text: wraps or not on a fraction of a pixel
